chunks: Hammad ibn Uthman narrated to us from Bashir al-Attar who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:
We are a people whom God has made obedience to obligatory, and you are following one whose ignorance people cannot be excused for.

key_terms.فَرَضَ اللَّهُ طَاعَتَنَا: God has made obedience to us obligatory — a divine decree establishing the Imamate
key_terms.لَا يُعْذَرُ النَّاسُ بِجَهَالَتِهِ: People cannot be excused for ignorance of him — knowledge of the Imam is a binding religious duty

ai.seo_question: Is obedience to the Imams of Ahlulbayt obligatory in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) delivers a foundational doctrinal statement on the obligatory nature of obedience to the Imams of Ahl al-Bayt. He declares that God has made obedience to them (the Imams) a divine obligation, and that people cannot be excused for ignorance of them — implying that knowing and following the rightful Imam is a religious duty. This teaching directly supports the Shia doctrine of the Imamate as a divine institution, not a matter of personal choice or political arrangement.
